The long brick arsenal ranges with slate roofs and cupolas around the parade green, and the corbelled brick tower — the Armory National Historic Site grounds.

Shift to State St-corridor commercial vernacular (D&W Fashions, Italian Bread Shop at Oakland/Orange, Sang Phở Gà at 2 Wilmont St) and brick walk-ups. Wilmont St sits in Springfield's Old Hill/Bay area — confirm which side.
The Campanile clock tower of the Springfield Municipal Group, downtown.

Hartford: the Colt Armory's blue star-spangled onion dome and the lettered COLT chimney — Coltsville National Historical Park. NOTE 7629/7630 (generating plant, Eversource yard) sit just before the Colt frames and could still be Springfield riverfront; check before applying.
